nodes.author: bhalomanush
nodes.text: Don’t fall for the scary headlines. Human metapneumovirus has already infected you before and it’s not going to cause the next pandemic. https://t.co/Z0DlqnKcJA

nodes.author: bhalomanush
nodes.text: I’ve got more in my newsletter, but by five pretty much everyone has been infected by it. By now you’ve been infected many times. You just don’t know it because you’ve never been tested for it.

nodes.author: bhalomanush
nodes.text:
Ironically, one big reason that cases are popping up now is we got better at testing for infectious diseases after COVID.

Anyway,  there are quite a few scary viruses out there, believe me. For the general public, this is not one of them.

nodes.author: bhalomanush
nodes.text: Recent reports of increased hMPV cases in China have been EXAGGERATED, since surveillance data shows levels within the usual range for the season, with influenza being the dominant respiratory illness.

nodes.author: bhalomanush
nodes.text: A lot of this panic was created by Indian media either willfully or out of ignorant distortion of risk. Hints of lockdowns, case-tracking, or “COVID-like” threats stir up attention and fear, even when science tells us otherwise.

nodes.author: bhalomanush
nodes.text:
Two things have happened here. Indian news started covering this over the break and it turned into a frenzy— but only in India. 🤔 

Second, the government kept saying things are under control, which in this climate had the exact opposite effect on everyone. 🙃

nodes.text: @bhalomanush 'A burnt child dreads the fire' fits here perfectly I guess.

nodes.author: bhalomanush
nodes.text: @AdityaMishra_ Understood. But to scream fire in a theater when there is none is also unethical.
